And ﴿أَنْ تَقْتُلَنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by أن; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is the object of تريد. ﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a particle of comparison and genitive, and ما is maṣdariyya. ﴿قَتَلْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿نَفْساً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِالْأَمْسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar from ما and the verb is in the position of genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أَنْ﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is إِنْ.]»: negative. ﴿تُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ تَكُونَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by أن, and its noun is latent. ﴿جَبَّاراً﴾: its khabar; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and what follows it is the object of تريد. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جبارا. ﴿وَما تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it, and its i'rab is clear.

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿وَجاءَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿جاءَ رَجُلٌ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And ﴿مِنْ أَقْصَى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رجل. ﴿الْمَدِينَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يَسْعى﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is a second naʿt of رجل. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā); the vocative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الْمَلَأَ﴾: its noun. ﴿يَأْتَمِرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿بِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿لِيَقْتُلُوكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf its object. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يأتمرون. ﴿فَاخْرُجْ﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition). ﴿اخرج﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to الناصحين. ﴿مِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إنّ; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿فَخَرَجَ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿خرج﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿خائِفاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَتَرَقَّبُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; the vocative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿نَجِّنِي﴾: a verb of supplication and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is also the object of the saying. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

daas-irab:22-22.t:
﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَمَّا﴾: temporal and conditional. ﴿تَوَجَّهَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿تِلْقاءَ﴾: an adverb of place. ﴿مَدْيَنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position.
﴿عَسى﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنْ يَهْدِيَنِي﴾: an imperfect verb of supplication, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is the khabar (predicate) of عسى. ﴿سَواءَ﴾: accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿السَّبِيلِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause عسى is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:23-23.t:
﴿وَلَمَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿وَرَدَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿ماءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَدْيَنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَجَدَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿أُمَّةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أمة. ﴿يَسْقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَوَجَدَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿امْرَأَتَيْنِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَذُودانِ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of امرأتين.
﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿خَطْبُكُما﴾: khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَتا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا﴾: negative; and ﴿نَسْقِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يُصْدِرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after حتى. ﴿الرِّعاءُ﴾: fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَأَبُونا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is one of the Five Nouns. ﴿شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ﴾: two khabars; the nominal clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿فَسَقى﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهُما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تَوَلَّى﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to سقى. ﴿إِلَى الظِّلِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فَقالَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and قال is a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لِما﴾: ما is a relative, genitive by the lām; [both] are attached to فقير. ﴿أَنْزَلْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَى﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is إِلَيَّ.]»: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَقِيرٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; the nominal clause is the object of the saying.

daas-irab:25-25.t:
﴿فَجاءَتْهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its object. ﴿إِحْداهُما﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the alif because it is a dual «[Translator's note: so in the source; إحدى is singular and is nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif; the dual sense belongs to the pronoun هما.]»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿تَمْشِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلَى اسْتِحْياءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl. ﴿قالَتْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause جاءته by an omitted conjunction. ﴿إِنَّ أَبِي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿يَدْعُوكَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لِيَجْزِيَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām of causation (taʿlīl); the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَجْرَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿سَقَيْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿جاءَهُ﴾: a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَقَصَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْقَصَصَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا تَخَفْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿نَجَوْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of القوم.

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿قالَتْ إِحْداهُما﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أَبَتِ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿اسْتَأْجِرْهُ﴾: an imperative verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿إِنَّ خَيْرَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿مَنِ﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿اسْتَأْجَرْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿الْقَوِيُّ الْأَمِينُ﴾: two khabars (predicates) of إنّ; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:27-27.t:
﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿أُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنْ أُنْكِحَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِحْدَى﴾: its second object. ﴿ابْنَتَيَّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هاتَيْنِ﴾: the hā is for alerting (tanbīh), and the demonstrative is a naʿt (adjective) of ابنتي; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is the object of أريد. ﴿عَلى﴾: a preposition. ﴿أَنْ تَأْجُرَنِي﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by أن; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by على, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ثَمانِيَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿حِجَجٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and إن is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَتْمَمْتَ﴾: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its fāʿil. ﴿عَشْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَمِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa). ﴿من عندك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle and ما is negative. ﴿أُرِيدُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنْ أَشُقَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by أن, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is the object of أريد. ﴿سَتَجِدُنِي﴾: the sīn is for the future. ﴿وتجدني﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And ﴿أَنْ﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is إِنْ.]»: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿شاءَ﴾: a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb ستجدني; and the clause ﴿إِنْ شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بَيْنِي﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَبَيْنَكَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to بيني. ﴿أَيَّمَا﴾: أيّ is a jussive conditional noun in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of قضيت, and ما is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿الْأَجَلَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قَضَيْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and لا operates like إنّ. ﴿عُدْوانَ﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of لا; the nominal clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word here is عَلى.]»: a preposition. ﴿ما﴾: a noun genitive by على; both are attached to وكيل. ﴿نَقُولُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكِيلٌ﴾: the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿قَضى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. ﴿مُوسَى﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْأَجَلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَسارَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and سار is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to قضى. ﴿بِأَهْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿آنَسَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ جانِبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الطُّورِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ناراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِأَهْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿امْكُثُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿آنَسْتُ ناراً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إني, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَعَلِّي﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿آتِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is likewise causal. ﴿مِنْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿بِخَبَرٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the verb. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿جَذْوَةٍ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَ النَّارِ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of جذوة. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿تَصْطَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:30-30.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿أَتاها﴾: a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿نُودِيَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿مِنْ شاطِئِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْوادِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْأَيْمَنِ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of الوادي. ﴿فِي الْبُقْعَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb نودي. ﴿الْمُبارَكَةِ﴾: a naʿt of البقعة. The clause نودي is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ﴾: a badal (substitute) from His words من شاطئ الوادي. ﴿أَنْ﴾: explicative (mufassira). ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā). ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿أَنَا﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿رَبُّ﴾: a second khabar. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause أن يا موسى is explicative, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿وَأَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أَنْ﴾: explicative (mufassira). ﴿أَلْقِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَصاكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is explicative, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿رَآها﴾: a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿تَهْتَزُّ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿كَأَنَّها﴾: كأنّ and its noun. ﴿جَانٌّ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is likewise a ḥāl. ﴿وَلَّى﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مُدْبِراً﴾: ḥāl; the clause is the answer of لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿يُعَقِّبْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā). ﴿أَقْبِلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the speech is resumptive. ﴿وَلا تَخَفْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive by the lā of prohibition, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْآمِنِينَ﴾: the khabar of إنّ; the clause gives the cause of the command.

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿اسْلُكْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿يَدَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي جَيْبِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿تَخْرُجْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿بَيْضاءَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ غَيْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of بيضاء. ﴿سُوءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاضْمُمْ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to اسلك. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿جَناحَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الرَّهْبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the verb. ﴿فَذانِكَ﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بُرْهانانِ﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: a naʿt of برهانان. ﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the kāf. ﴿وَمَلَائِهِ﴾: conjoined to فرعون. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿قَوْماً﴾: its khabar. ﴿فاسِقِينَ﴾: a naʿt of قوما; the verbal clause is the khabar of إنهم, and the nominal clause gives the cause of the two proofs that were sent.

daas-irab:33-33.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿قَتَلْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿نَفْساً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إني. The two clauses, the nominal and the vocative, are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَأَخافُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿أَنْ يَقْتُلُونِ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ of the speaker is the mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is a mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:34-34.t: ﴿وَأَخِي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هارُونُ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿هُوَ أَفْصَحُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the khabar of أخي. ﴿مِنِّي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أفصح. ﴿لِساناً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿فَأَرْسِلْهُ﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and a verb of supplication and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿مَعِي﴾: an adverb of place. ﴿رِدْءاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿يُصَدِّقُنِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ردءا. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿أَخافُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَنْ يُكَذِّبُونِ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the wāw is its fāʿil, the nūn is for protection, and the omitted yāʾ of the speaker is the mafʿūl bihi. The clause أخاف is the khabar of إني, the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is the object of أخاف, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:35-35.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿سَنَشُدُّ﴾: the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَضُدَكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِأَخِيكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَنَجْعَلُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿نَجْعَلُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَكُما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and لا is negative. ﴿يَصِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْكُما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before them. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to يصلون. ﴿أَنْتُما﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَمَنِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَمَنِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿اتَّبَعَكُمَا﴾: a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿الْغالِبُونَ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿مُوسى﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. The clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿هذا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿سِحْرٌ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُفْتَرىً﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of سحر; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿سَمِعْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهذا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فِي آبائِنَا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾: a naʿt of آبائنا; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿وَقالَ مُوسى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿بِمَنْ﴾: من is a relative noun, genitive by the bāʾ; [both] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعلم; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿جاءَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِالْهُدى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is conjoined to the one before it. ﴿تَكُونُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted, fronted khabar of تكون. ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾: its postponed noun. ﴿الدَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of إنّ, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:38-38.t: ﴿وَقالَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿قالَ فِرْعَوْنُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative. ﴿ها﴾: for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿الْمَلَأُ﴾: badal (substitute) from أيها. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿عَلِمْتُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿إِلهٍ﴾: genitive in form and accusative in position, the object of علمت. ﴿غَيْرِي﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of إله; the two clauses are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَأَوْقِدْ﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿يا هامانُ﴾: the one addressed, a single proper noun (mufrad ʿalam), indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of accusative. ﴿عَلَى الطِّينِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the vocative clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa). ﴿فَاجْعَلْ لِي﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فأوقد لي. ﴿صَرْحاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَعَلِّي﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿أَطَّلِعُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلى إِلهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنِّي﴾: the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَأَظُنُّهُ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿أظنه﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْكاذِبِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb, and both are in the place of the second object; the verbal clause is the khabar of إني, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:39-39.t: ﴿وَاسْتَكْبَرَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿اسْتَكْبَرَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿هُوَ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil. ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿جُنُودُهُ﴾: conjoined to the latent fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ظَنُّوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: أنّ and its noun; the clause stands in place of the two objects of ظنوا. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb after them. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يُرْجَعُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أنّ.

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿فَأَخَذْناهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَجُنُودَهُ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the accusative pronoun. ﴿فَنَبَذْناهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي الْيَمِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun, the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾: the postponed noun of كان. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause كيف كان.. stands in place of the two objects of انظر.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿وَجَعَلْناهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿أَئِمَّةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَى النَّارِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of أئمة. The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يُنْصَرُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:42-42.t: ﴿وَأَتْبَعْناهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: badal (substitute) from the demonstrative. ﴿لَعْنَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ الْمَقْبُوحِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, the lām falls in the answer to the oath, and the thing sworn by is omitted. ﴿قد﴾: a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مُوسَى﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the answer to the implied oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾: maṣdariyya. ﴿أَهْلَكْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْقُرُونَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْأُولى﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of القرون; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ما and the verb is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿بَصائِرَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بصائر. ﴿وَهُدىً﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to بصائر. ﴿وَرَحْمَةً﴾: also conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:44-44.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle and ما is negative. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿بِجانِبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of كنت. ﴿الْغَرْبِيِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿قَضَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلى مُوسَى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَمْرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَما كُنْتَ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it, and its i'rab is clear.

daas-irab:45-45.t: ﴿وَلكِنَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَلكِنَّا﴾: لكنّ and its noun. ﴿أَنْشَأْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿قُرُوناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of لكنّ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿فَتَطاوَلَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْعُمُرُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negative. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿ثاوِياً﴾: its khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي أَهْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ثاويا. ﴿مَدْيَنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَتْلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿آياتِنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلكِنَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَلكِنَّا﴾: لكنّ and its noun. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: an incomplete past verb and its noun. ﴿مُرْسِلِينَ﴾: its khabar; the verbal clause is the khabar of لكنّ. The nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle and ما is negative. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿بِجانِبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of كنت. ﴿الطُّورِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿نادَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لكِنْ﴾: a particle of rectification (istidrāk), without governing effect (muhmal). ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of رحمة. ﴿لِتُنْذِرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿قَوْماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implicit أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted, implied verb. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿أَتاهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿نَذِيرٍ﴾: genitive in form and nominative in position, the fāʿil of أتاهم; the clause is a naʿt of قوما. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نذير. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is causal, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:47-47.t: ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and لولا is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنْ تُصِيبَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the hāʾ is its object. ﴿مُصِيبَةٌ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what follows it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted. ﴿بِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿فَيَقُولُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿يقولوا﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to تصيبهم. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), in construct. ﴿لَوْلا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿أَرْسَلْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya). ﴿نتبع﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit أن after the fāʾ, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿آياتِكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَنَكُونَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb conjoined to نتبع, and its noun is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of نكون.

daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿جاءَهُمُ﴾: a past verb and its object. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَوْلا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿أُوتِيَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِثْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أُوتِيَ﴾: a passive past verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾: nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿لَمْ يَكْفُرُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أُوتِيَ مُوسى﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿سِحْرانِ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿تَظاهَرا﴾: a past verb, and the alif is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of سحران. ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿إِنَّا﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿بِكُلٍّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كافرون. ﴿كافِرُونَ﴾: the khabar of إنّ; the nominal clause is the object of the saying.

daas-irab:49-49.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأْتُوا﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِكِتابٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كتاب. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَهْدى﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is a second naʿt of كتاب. ﴿مِنْهُما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أهدى. ﴿أَتَّبِعْهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾: its khabar; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the apodosis is omitted.

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿فَإِنْ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the conditional particle here is إِنْ.]»: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَاعْلَمْ﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَنَّما﴾: [أنّ] restrained [from governing] by the restraining [mā] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿يَتَّبِعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause أنما يتبعون.. is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) standing in place of the two objects of اعلم. The wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَضَلُّ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِمَّنِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أضل. ﴿اتَّبَعَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿هَواهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿هُدىً﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by من, and both are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of هدى. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: إنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْقَوْمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: a naʿt of القوم; the verbal clause is the khabar of إنّ, and the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:51-51.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in ayah 43. ﴿وَصَّلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَهُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْقَوْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the answer to the implied oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil.
The verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعلّ, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:52-52.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آتَيْناهُمُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb after them. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of هم, and the nominal clause الذين.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:53-53.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إذا is temporal, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿يُتْلى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the answer of إذا, with no grammatical position. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the verbal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّنا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial); the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إِنَّا﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what follows them. ﴿مُسْلِمِينَ﴾: the khabar of كنا; the clause كنا.. is the khabar of إنا, and the clause إنا.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُؤْتَوْنَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿أَجْرَهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مَرَّتَيْنِ﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, standing in for the absolute object). ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya. ﴿صَبَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ما and the verb is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يؤتون. ﴿وَيَدْرَؤُنَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿بِالْحَسَنَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿السَّيِّئَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb ينفقون. ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the clause يؤتون, so it is in the position of nominative like it.

daas-irab:55-55.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إذا is temporal, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿سَمِعُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿اللَّغْوَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَعْرَضُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the answer of إذا, with no grammatical position. And the clause إذا.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿لَنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَعْمالُنا﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلَكُمْ أَعْمالُكُمْ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿سَلامٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar; the nominal clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿نَبْتَغِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْجاهِلِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:56-56.t:
﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿تَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَنْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنك, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَحْبَبْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a particle resembling the verb. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَنْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of لكنّ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent.
The clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar. ﴿بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعلم; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:57-57.t:
﴿وَقالُوا﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿نَتَّبِعِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْهُدى﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿مَعَكَ﴾: an adverb of place. ﴿نُتَخَطَّفْ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿مِنْ أَرْضِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; and إن and what follows it are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿نُمَكِّنْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by لم, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿حَرَماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آمِناً﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of حرما; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُجْبى﴾: a passive imperfect verb. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿ثَمَراتُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿كُلِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a second naʿt of حرما. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مِنْ لَدُنَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to رزقا. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾: the noun of لكنّ. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of لكنّ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿وَكَمْ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿كَمْ﴾: predicative (khabariyya), in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, the tamyīz (specification) of كم; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَطِرَتْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مَعِيشَتَها﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of قرية. ﴿فَتِلْكَ مَساكِنُهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿لَمْ تُسْكَنْ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْوارِثِينَ﴾: its khabar; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:59-59.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle; ما is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: its noun. ﴿مُهْلِكَ﴾: its khabar (predicate). ﴿الْقُرى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يَبْعَثَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implicit أن and what follows it is in the position of genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) مهلك. ﴿فِي أُمِّها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَتْلُوا﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿آياتِنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of رسولا. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿مُهْلِكِي﴾: its khabar. ﴿الْقُرى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿وَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial. ﴿أَهْلُها ظالِمُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:60-60.t: ﴿وَما﴾: ما is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أُوتِيتُمْ﴾: a passive past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَمَتاعُ﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: naʿt (adjective); the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ما. ﴿وَزِينَتُها﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to متاع. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَبْقى﴾: conjoined to خير. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). The verbal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:61-61.t: ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾: the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿مِنَ﴾ «[Translator's note: so vocalized in the source; the word is the relative مَنْ.]»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَعَدْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿وَعْداً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَسَناً﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of وعدا. ﴿فَهُوَ لاقِيهِ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿كَمَنْ﴾: من is relative, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ من. ﴿مَتَّعْناهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila of من. ﴿مَتاعَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿الْحَياةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾: naʿt. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:62-62.t: ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر يوم" (remember the day). ﴿يُنادِيهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَيَقُولُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿أَيْنَ﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿شُرَكائِيَ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective) of شركائي. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿تَزْعُمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The two objects of تزعمون are omitted because what precedes them indicates them.

daas-irab:63-63.t: ﴿قالَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿حَقَّ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْقَوْلُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), in construct. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿أَغْوَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَغْوَيْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هؤلاء. ﴿كَما﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿غَوَيْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ثم﴾: conjunctive. ﴿تَبَرَّأْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿إِيَّانا﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَعْبُدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كانوا, and the clause ما كانوا.. is a second ḥāl.

daas-irab:64-64.t:
﴿وَقِيلَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿قِيلَ﴾: a passive past verb. ﴿ادْعُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿شُرَكاءَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَدَعَوْهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿فَلَمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿يَسْتَجِيبُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.
﴿وَرَأَوُا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; رأوا is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾: أنّ and its noun. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿يَهْتَدُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا, and the clause كانوا.. is the khabar of أنّ. The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أنّ, its noun and its khabar is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb.

daas-irab:65-65.t: ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يوم is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, اذكر (remember). ﴿يُنادِيهِمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَيَقُولُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿ماذا﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أَجَبْتُمُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْمُرْسَلِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:66-66.t: ﴿فَعَمِيَتْ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle; عميت is a passive past verb «[Translator's note: so in the source; عَمِيَتْ is in the active voice, and الأنباء is its fāʿil (agent).]», and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْأَنْباءُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb of time annexed to its like. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَتَساءَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:67-67.t: ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle. ﴿أما﴾: a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl). ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تابَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿وَآمَنَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to تاب. ﴿وَعَمِلَ﴾: also conjoined. ﴿صالِحاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَعَسى﴾: the fāʾ falls in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿عسى﴾: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿أَنْ﴾: a particle that puts in the accusative. ﴿يَكُونَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and its noun is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْمُفْلِحِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكون; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what follows it is the khabar of عسى, the clause عسى.. is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من, and the clause أما من.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:68-68.t: ﴿وَرَبُّكَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَخْلُقُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿ما﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿وَيَخْتارُ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يخلق. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿الْخِيَرَةُ﴾: its postponed noun; the verbal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿سُبْحانَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَتَعالى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما.

daas-irab:69-69.t: ﴿وَرَبُّكَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿يُعْلِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما.

daas-irab:70-70.t: ﴿وَهُوَ اللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation, operating like إنّ. ﴿إِلهَ﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾: badal (substitute) from the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar of لا; the nominal clause is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو. ﴿لَهُ﴾: a fronted khabar. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو. ﴿فِي الْأُولى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) الحمد. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾: conjoined to الأولى. ﴿وَلَهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a fronted khabar. ﴿الْحُكْمُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to what follows them. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:71-71.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is a particle of interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سَرْمَداً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جعل. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَنْ إِلهٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿غَيْرُ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of إله. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَأْتِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِضِياءٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the verbal clause is a naʿt of إله. ﴿أَفَلا﴾: the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and لا is negative. ﴿تَسْمَعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

dervis-irab:1-6.t:
* Vocabulary:
(شِيَعاً): In al-Qāmūs, al-Tāj and other lexicons: "A man's shīʿa are his followers and supporters; the plural is shiyaʿ and ashyāʿ. Al-shīʿa is a faction, and it applies to one, two and many, masculine and feminine. This name has come to be applied predominantly to everyone who takes ʿAlī and the people of his house as patrons, until it became a name specific to them; the singular is shīʿī." Al-Zamakhsharī said: "Shiyaʿan: factions who follow him in whatever he wants and obey him, none of them able to turn his neck away. Al-Aʿshā said:
وبلدة يرهب الجواب دلجتها ... حتى تراه عليها يبتغي الشيعا
(Many a land whose night journey the seasoned traveller dreads, so that you see him in it seeking companions.)
Or: some of them follow others in obeying him; or: classes [of people] in his service, employing one class in building, one class in tilling and one class in digging, and whoever he did not employ he imposed tribute upon; or: divergent factions among whom he stirred up enmity." The meaning of the verse al-Zamakhsharī cited from al-Aʿshā: Many a desert the jawwāb — that is, the much-travelled one, from jubtu al-arḍa, "I crossed the land by travelling" — fears; and al-dulja is from dalaja, adlaja and iddalaja, to travel by night, al-dulja being an hour of the night. That is: the one accustomed to travel fears travelling through it by night, so that he seeks groups who will help him travel through it. After the verse come his words:
كلفت مجهولها نفسي وشايعني ... همّي عليها إذا ما آلها لمعا
(I burdened myself with its unknown tracts, and my resolve accompanied me over it when its mirage gleamed.)
بذات لوث عفرناة إذا عثرت ... فالتعس أولى لها من أن يقال لعا
(On a strong, stout she-camel; if she stumbles, "May she fall!" suits her better than "Rise up!")
He says: I burdened myself with travelling its unknown parts, and my resolve returned to me for travelling through it at the time its āl gleamed — the āl being the mirage seen in intense heat as though it were water — even though travelling in the midday heat is harder than travelling by night. Then he said: with a she-camel possessed of strength; lawth is also used for weakness, so it is one of the aḍdād (words with opposite meanings). ʿAfarnāh: thick-set. To one who stumbles it is said "laʿan laka," a prayer for him to recover, and "taʿsan lahu," a prayer against him that he fall. He means that she does not stumble, and were she to stumble, the prayer against her would be more fitting for her than the prayer for her.
(وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِساءَهُمْ): he kept them alive, because one of the soothsayers had told him that a child would be born among the Children of Israel who would be the cause of the end of his kingdom.
(هامانَ): the vizier of Pharaoh mentioned here. [There is also] Haman the enemy of the Jews, the vizier of Ahasuerus the Persian, mentioned in the Book of Esther among the books of the Old Testament.

* I'rab:
(طسم تِلْكَ آياتُ الْكِتابِ الْمُبِينِ): What is to be said about it has already preceded. (تلك) is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and (آيات الكتاب المبين) its khabar (predicate). (نَتْلُوا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَبَإِ مُوسى وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ): (نتلو) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "naḥnu". (عليك) is attached (mutaʿalliq) to (نتلو). (من نبأ) is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "something of the story of Moses and Pharaoh"; in it the qualified noun is omitted and the adjective put in its place. (بالحق) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of (نتلو), i.e. "while We are clothed in truth and veracity", or from the object, i.e. "while it is clothed in truth and veracity". (لقوم) is attached to (نتلو), and it stands as its reason, i.e. "for the sake of a people". The clause (يؤمنون) is an adjective of (قوم). (إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَها شِيَعاً): a resumptive statement brought to set out the story of Pharaoh, or an explicative clause for the tidings of Moses; both of them have no grammatical position. (إن) and its noun, and the clause (علا) is its khabar; the agent of (علا) is a pronoun latent by option, its implied form being "huwa", i.e. Pharaoh. (في الأرض) is attached to (علا). (جعل أهلها): a verb, a latent agent and the first object; (شيعا) is the second object. (يَسْتَضْعِفُ طائِفَةً مِنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْناءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِساءَهُمْ إِنَّهُ كانَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ): the clause (يستضعف) is a ḥāl from the agent of (جعل), or an adjective of (شيعا), and you may make it a resumptive statement. The agent of (يستضعف) is "huwa", and (طائفة) is the direct object; (منهم) is an adjective of (طائفة). (يذبح) is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from (يستضعف), because the oppression includes both the slaughtering and the sparing. (أبناءهم) is the object of (يذبح), and (يستحيي نساءهم) is conjoined to (يذبح أبناءهم). The clause (إنه) is a reason for these acts: (إن) and its noun, and the clause (كان) is its khabar; the noun of (كان) is latent, its implied form being "huwa", and (من المفسدين) is the khabar of (كان). Pharaoh slaughtered their sons and left the women only because the astrologers of that age told him that his kingdom would go at the hand of a child from the Children of Israel. Al-Zajjāj said: "Astonishing is Pharaoh's folly! For if the soothsayer who told him that was truthful in his view, then killing would be of no use, and if he was lying, then there was no point in killing."
(وَنُرِيدُ أَنْ نَمُنَّ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ): the wāw is conjunctive or circumstantial. If you make it conjunctive, you conjoin the statement to His words (إن فرعون علا في الأرض), because it is its counterpart in serving as an explanation of the tidings of Moses and Pharaoh, and the imperfect form is for narrating a past state. If you make it circumstantial, the clause is a ḥāl from (يستضعف), i.e. "Pharaoh oppresses them while We wish to bestow favour upon them". (أن) and what falls within its scope is the object of (نريد). (على الذين) is attached to (نمن), and the clause (استضعفوا) is the ṣila (relative clause). (في الأرض) is attached to (استضعفوا), or to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "while they are on the earth", and perhaps this is preferable. (وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ أَئِمَّةً وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ الْوارِثِينَ): (نجعلهم) is conjoined to (نمنّ); the hāʾ is the first object and (أئمة) the second object. (نجعلهم الوارثين) is conjoined to (نجعلهم أئمة). (وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَنُرِيَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهامانَ وَجُنُودَهُما مِنْهُمْ ما كانُوا يَحْذَرُونَ): (نمكن) is conjoined to (نجعل), its agent latent, its implied form being "naḥnu"; (لهم) is attached to (نمكن), and (في الأرض) is a ḥāl. (نري) is also conjoined; (فرعون) is the direct object, (هامان) is conjoined to (فرعون), and (جنودهما) is conjoined to (فرعون وهامان). (منهم) is attached to (نري), i.e. "and We show Pharaoh, Haman and their hosts, from the Children of Israel, what they used to beware of", i.e. what they feared from them — and it did happen at the hand of a child from among them. (ما) is the second object of (نري); the clause (كانوا) is the ṣila; (كان) and its noun, and the clause (يحذرون) is the khabar of (كانوا).

dervis-irab:47-50.t:
* I'rab:
(وَلَوْلا أَنْ تُصِيبَهُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ بِما قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ): the wāw is a conjunction; (لولا) is the particle of non-occurrence because of occurrence (ḥarf imtināʿ li-wujūd); (أن) and what falls within its scope is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, as the well-known rule has it, i.e. "and were it not for the calamity befalling them"; its answer is omitted, its implied form being "We would not have sent a messenger". (مصيبة) is the fāʿil (agent); (بما) are attached (mutaʿalliq) to (تصيبهم); and the clause (قدمت) is the ṣila (relative clause). (فَيَقُولُوا رَبَّنا لَوْلا أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ آياتِكَ وَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ): the fāʾ is a conjunction and (يقولوا) is conjoined to (أن تصيبهم); (ربنا) is a muḍāf vocative (munādā); (لولا) is the particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), meaning "why not"; (أرسلت) is a verb and its agent; (إلينا) are attached to (أرسلت); (رسولا) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). In (فنتبع) the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation, and (نتبع) is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation; the agent of (نتبع) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we"; (آياتك) is the direct object; (نكون) is conjoined to (نتبع); the noun of (نكون) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we", and (من المؤمنين) is its khabar.
This verse has occupied the commentators and the grammarians. Al-Zamakhsharī said:
"If you say: How does this meaning hold good, when the punishment has been made the cause of sending, not the saying, since the particle of non-occurrence has been put on it and not on the saying? I say: The saying is what is intended to be the cause of sending the messengers; but since the punishment was the cause of the saying, and the saying exists through its existence, the punishment was made as though it were the cause of the sending by means of the saying, so لولا was put on it, and the saying was brought conjoined to it with the fāʾ that gives the sense of causation. Its meaning comes down to your saying: 'Were it not for this saying of theirs when a calamity befalls them, We would not have sent.' But this way was chosen for a subtle point, namely that if they were not, for example, punished for their unbelief, having witnessed that by which they were driven to certain knowledge, they would not say: «لولا أرسلت إلينا رسولا»; rather, the cause of this saying of theirs is the punishment and nothing else, not regret at the faith in their Creator that they have missed. In this there is a strong testimony, which is not hidden, to how firmly their unbelief is rooted and established in them."
The secret of making the cause of the cause a cause, and conjoining the original cause to it, is twofold. First, that greater concern requires putting first, and this is the secret that Sībawayh pointed out. Second, that in this arrangement there is a reminder of the causality of each of the two: the first because it is joined to the particle of causation, namely أن, and the second because it is joined to the fāʾ of causation. Some grammarians used to raise a difficulty with this verse, saying: «لولا», according to the specialists, indicates the non-occurrence of its answer because of the occurrence [Translator's note: the printed text has «لوجو», evidently for «لوجود»] of what follows it. In that case what comes after it in the verse would be existent, namely the punishment of these people on the supposition that messengers were not sent, and its omitted answer would not occur, namely not sending, because it is a fortiori impossible. And when not-sending does not occur, sending necessarily occurs. So what comes after it becomes problematic, since there is no wrongdoing before the sending of messengers, and so punishment on the supposition that none were sent is inconceivable; for it occurs as recompense for violating the rulings of the Law, and if there is no Law there is no violation and no punishment. And the answer becomes problematic for the grammarians, because it is required not to occur, namely the non-sending of messengers, yet what comes after it requires its occurrence. The precise statement of the meaning of لولا is that it indicates that what follows it is a preventer of its answer, the reverse of «لو», whose meaning is that its answer is necessitated by what follows it. Then the preventer may be existent, or it may be supposed, and the verse is of the kind in which the existence of the preventer is supposed. Likewise the necessity in «لو»: one thing may be necessitated by two things, so its negation does not follow from the negation of one of the two things that necessitate it. On this precise statement the difficulty disappears.
(فَلَمَّا جاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِنا قالُوا لَوْلا أُوتِيَ مِثْلَ ما أُوتِيَ مُوسى): the fāʾ is a conjunction; (لما) is temporal ("when") or a linking particle; (جاءهم الحق) is a past verb, a direct object put first and an agent put after; (من عندنا) are attached to (جاءهم); the clause (قالوا) has no grammatical position because it is the answer of (لما); (لولا) is a particle of urging, i.e. "why not"; (أوتي) is a past verb whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, its implied form being "he", i.e. Muḥammad ﷺ; (مثل) is a second direct object; (ما) is a relative noun, the muḍāf ilayhi of (مثل); the clause (أوتي) is the ṣila; and (موسى) is the deputy agent. (أَوَلَمْ يَكْفُرُوا بِما أُوتِيَ مُوسى مِنْ قَبْلُ): the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval and affirmation; the wāw is conjoined to something implied that the context calls for; (لم) is a particle of negation, conversion [of tense] and jussive; (يكفروا) is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by (لم); (بما) are attached to (يكفروا); the clause (أوتي موسى) is the ṣila; (من قبل) are attached to (أولم يكفروا) or to (أوتي). The meaning then is that the people of Mecca who said this, just as they disbelieved in Muḥammad and in the Qur'an, had disbelieved in Moses and in the Torah.
(قالُوا سِحْرانِ تَظاهَرا وَقالُوا إِنَّا بِكُلٍّ كافِرُونَ): the clause (قالوا) is explicative; (سحران) is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "they are two sorcerers" [Translator's note: the text glosses with «ساحران» though the reading cited is «سحران»]; the clause (تظاهرا) is a naʿt (adjective) of (سحران), i.e. they supported one another, each confirming the other; (قالوا) is conjoined to (قالوا); (إنا) is inna and its noun; (بكل) are attached to (كافرون); (كافرون) is the khabar of (إنا); and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). (قُلْ فَأْتُوا بِكِتابٍ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ هُوَ أَهْدى مِنْهُما أَتَّبِعْهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صادِقِينَ): (قل) is an imperative verb whose agent is latent, its implied form being "you"; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); (أتوا) is an imperative verb; (بكتاب) are attached to (فأتوا); (من عند الله) are attached to an omitted adjective; (هو) is a mubtadaʾ and (أهدى) the khabar; (منهما) are attached to (أهدى); and the clause is a second adjective of (كتاب). (أتبعه) is an imperfect verb in the jussive because it is the answer of the imperative; the agent is latent, its implied form being "I", and the hāʾ is the direct object. (إن) is conditional; (كنتم) is a past incomplete verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun and (صادقين) its khabar; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e. "then bring it". The imperative here is for showing inability, mixed with rebuke and reproach.
