He said: and thus I saw it in the muṣḥaf of ʿAbd Allāh, and it is so in our copies too.
His saying: ﴿لَخَسَفَ بِنَا﴾: the reading of the generality is (لَخُسِفَ). Shayba and al-Ḥasan — as far as I know — read it (لخَسَفَ بنا). In the reading of ʿAbd Allāh it is (لانْخُسِف بِنَا), and this is evidence for whoever reads ﴿لخُسِفَ﴾.

farraa:85-85.t: His saying: ﴿إِنَّ ٱلَّذِي فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ﴾: he says: [the One who] sent down the Qurʾān to you ﴿لَرَادُّكَ إلَى مَعَاد﴾. They mention that Jibrīl said: O Muhammad, do you long for your birthplace and your homeland? He said: yes. He said: so he said to him what was sent down to him: ﴿نَّ ٱلَّذِي فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْآنَ لَرَآدُّكَ إِلَىٰ مَعَادٍ﴾, meaning to Mecca. By al-maʿād here He meant only where you were born; it is not from al-ʿawd (returning). It may also be that His saying ﴿لرادُّكَ﴾ refers to your coming to return to Mecca, conquered for you; then al-maʿād is [an expression of] wonder: ﴿إلى مَعَادٍ﴾ — what a return! — because of what He promised him of the conquest of Mecca.

farraa:86-86.t: His saying: ﴿وَمَا كُنتَ تَرْجُوۤ أَن يُلْقَىٰ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَابُ إِلاَّ رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ﴾: except that your Lord had mercy on you ﴿فأنزل عليك﴾; so it is a discontinuous exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ). Its meaning is: you did not hope to know the books of the ancients and their stories, reciting them to the people of Mecca, when you were not present at them and did not witness them. The evidence for that is His saying in this sūra ﴿وَمَا كُنْتَ ثَاوِياً فى أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ تَتْلُو عليهِم آياتِنَا﴾, i.e. you recite to the people of Mecca the stories of Madyan and Mūsā, while you were not dwelling there, staying, so that you might see it and hear it. Likewise His saying ﴿وَمَا كُنْتَ بِجَانِبِ الغَرْبِىِّ﴾, and here you are reciting their stories and their affair. This is the mercy from his Lord.

farraa:88-88.t:
His saying: ﴿كُلُّ شَيْءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلاَّ وَجْهَهُ﴾: except Him.
The poet said:
أستغفرُ الله ذنباً لَسْتُ مُحْصِيهُ * رَبّ العِبَاد إليه الوَجْهُ وَالْعَمَلُ
(I ask forgiveness of Allah for sins I cannot count — the Lord of the servants, to Whom are the face and the deed.)
I.e. to Him I direct my deeds.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «نتلو» is resumptive. The preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «نتلو». «لقوم» is attached to «نتلو», and the clause «يؤمنون» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «شيعًا»: second object. The clause «يستضعف» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «جعل», and the clause «يذبح» is a badal (substitute) from «يستضعف». The clause «إنه كان» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items, and the preposition «من المفسدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن نمُنَّ» is the object of «نريد». The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «استضعفوا». The clause «ونريد أن نمُنَّ» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلا}, a verbal clause conjoined to a nominal one, because both of them are an explanation of the account (al-nabaʾ).

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «نري». «ما»: a relative noun, second object of «نري».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «وأوحينا» is resumptive. «أنْ» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative. The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أرضعيه», and the clause «إنَّا رادُّوه» is resumptive. The preposition «من المرسلين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of the active participle, i.e. "and making him one of the messengers".

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «فالتقطه» is resumptive. The lām in «ليكون» is that of outcome (lām al-ʿāqiba). The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدوًّا». The clause «إن فرعون..» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «وقالت امرأت» is resumptive. «قرت»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو" (he). The preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قرت عين». The clause «لا تقتلوه» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clause «عسى أن ينفعنا»; the interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of the complete (tāmm) «عسى». The clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of an implied verb, i.e. "they obeyed her while they did not perceive what it would lead to".

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «وأصبح» is resumptive. «إنْ» is lightened from the heavy (inna) and inoperative (muhmala); «كادت» is an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa). The clause «إن كادت» is resumptive. «لولا» is a particle of non-occurrence because of occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd). «أنْ» is a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "were it not that Our binding [of her heart] exists". The conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "she would have disclosed it".

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «فبصرت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قالت». The two prepositions «به» and «عن جنب» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «بصرت», and the clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «بصرت».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «وحرّمنا» is resumptive. The preposition «من قبل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حرّمنا». The clause «فقالت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «حرّمنا». The clause «يكفلونه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أهل», and the clause «وهم له ناصحون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يكفلونه».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «كي»: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by an implied lām. The second interpreted maṣdar «ولتعلم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding maṣdar. The interpreted maṣdar formed from أنَّ and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «تعلم». The clause «ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «فرددناه».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «حُكْمًا»: second object. The clause «نجزي» is parenthetical, and the wāw is parenthetical. The kāf is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We reward the doers of good with a reward like that reward".

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «ودخل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the conditional clause, and «على» in the sense of «في» (in) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «دخل». The preposition «من أهلها» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «غفلة», and the clause «يقتتلان» is a naʿt. The clause «هذا من شيعته» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يقتتلان». The clause «فاستغاثه» is conjoined to the clause «وجد». The preposition «مِنْ عدوه» is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «إنه عدو» is a ḥāl from «الشيطان».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «فاغفر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ظلمت». «هو»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ, and the clause «إنه هو الغفور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The bāʾ is a preposition, of causation, and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "protect me because of Your favour". The implied clause «اعصمني» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. The clause «فلن أكون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the implied verb. The preposition «للمجرمين» is attached to the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «فأصبح» is resumptive, and the clause «يترقَّب» is a second khabar (predicate) of أصبح. The fāʾ in «فإذا» is a conjunction and «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أصبح». «مبين»: second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The first «أن» is redundant (zāʾida), and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يبطش» is the object of «أراد». The preposition «لهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدوّ». The kāf in «كما» is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the implied form is "a killing like your killing of a soul". «إنْ» is negating, and the maṣdar «أن تكون» is the object of «تريد». The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to «جبارًا». The clause «إنْ تريد إلا أن تكون» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The preposition «من أقصى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رجل», and the clause «يسعى» is a naʿt of «رجل». The clause «فاخرج» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إن الملأ يأتمرون بك». The clause «إني لك من الناصحين» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech; the preposition «لك» is attached to «الناصحين».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «يترقب» is a second ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خرج», and the clause «قال» is resumptive. «رب»: one addressed in the vocative, a muḍāf, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the omitted yāʾ of the speaker. «نجِّني»: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «تلقاء»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. «عسى»: an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and the interpreted maṣdar is the khabar (predicate) of عسى. «سواء»: second object.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ}. The preposition «من الناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أمة», and the clause «يَسْقون» is a naʿt of «أمة». The preposition «من دونهم» is attached to the verb وجد. The clause «تذودان» is a naʿt of «امرأتين». «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «خطبكما» is its khabar (predicate), and «ما» is the sign of the dual. The clause «قالتا» is resumptive, and the clause «وأبونا شيخ كبير» is conjoined to the clause «لا نسقي».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «فسقى» is resumptive. The lām in «لما» is a preposition, and «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive; the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزلت». The preposition «من خير» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما», and «فقير» is the khabar (predicate) of «إني».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «فجاءته» is resumptive, and the clause «تمشي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «جاءته». The preposition «على استحياء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «تمشي». «ما» in «ما سقيت» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "the wage of your watering". The clause «فلما جاءه» is resumptive, and «القصص» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «نجوت» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: His words «يا أبت»: one addressed in the vocative, a muḍāf, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which has been replaced by tāʾ; the kasra of the bāʾ was moved to the tāʾ, and the tāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «مَنْ»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. «القوي الأمين»: two khabars (predicates) of «إن». The clause «إن خير ...» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The interpreted maṣdar is the object of «أريد». «هاتين»: a demonstrative, a naʿt (adjective) interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "the two pointed to". The preposition and its genitive noun «على أن تأجرني», which is equivalent to a maṣdar, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent), i.e. "stipulating". «ثماني»: an adverb of time attached to «تأجرني», and the second object of «تأجرني» is omitted, i.e. "yourself". The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl). His words «فمن عندك»: the fāʾ is the linking one (rābiṭa), and the preposition is attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then the completion is from you". His words «عشرًا»: an adverb of time attached to «أتممت», and the tamyīz (specification) is omitted, i.e. "ten years (ḥijaj)", indicated by what precedes it. The clause «ستجدني» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech, and the clause «إن شاء الله» is parenthetical between the two objects of وجد; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The preposition «من الصالحين» is attached to the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The adverb «بيني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). «أيَّما»: a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); the fāʾ after it is the linking one (rābiṭa), and «لا» is the lā of generic negation together with its ism. The clause «قضيت» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech, and the clause «والله وكيل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قضيت». The preposition «على ما نقول» is attached to the khabar «وكيل».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «لما»: a particle of occurrence because of occurrence (wujūb li-wujūb). The preposition «من جانب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نارًا». The two prepositions «منها» and «بخبر» are attached to the verb «آتيكم». The preposition «من النار» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «جذوة». The clause «إني آنست» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech, and likewise the two clauses «لعلي» and «لعلكم».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The two prepositions «من شاطئ» and «في البقعة» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نُودي», and the third preposition «من الشجرة» is a badal (substitute) from «من الشاطئ», a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion). «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause «يا موسى» is explicative. The clause «إني أنا الله» is resumptive, the response to the vocative. «أنا»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun yāʾ. «رب»: badal from the Divine Name. «العالمين»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: His words «وأنْ ألق»: the wāw is a conjunction and «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya). The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ألق». The clause «تهتز» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «رآها», and the clause «كأنها جان» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «تهتز». The clause «ولَّى» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «مدبرا»: ḥāl from the fāʿil of «ولَّى». The clause «يا موسى» is resumptive, and the clause «إنك من الآمنين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «تخرج» is the apodosis of an implied condition. «بيضاء»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تخرج». The preposition «من غير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second ḥāl from the fāʿil of «تخرج», i.e. "being without…". The preposition «إليك» is attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I mean", and it is not attached to «اضمم», because in this category the verb of an attached latent pronoun does not pass over to its own attached pronoun; so one does not say "فرحت بي". The preposition «من الرهب» is attached to «اضمم». The clause «فذانك برهانان» is resumptive, within the scope of the response to the vocative. «من ربك» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «برهان». The demonstrative in His words «فذانك» has been made masculine although what it points to is the hand and the staff, both of which are feminine, because برهان (proof) is masculine and the mubtadaʾ (subject) is identical with the khabar (predicate) in meaning. The preposition «إلى فرعون» is attached to a second naʿt of «برهانان», and the clause «إنهم كانوا» is a ḥāl from «فرعون وملئه».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «فأخاف» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قتلت». «يقتلون»: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The interpreted maṣdar «أن يقتلون» is a mafʿūl bihi.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The clause «وأخي هارون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding content of speech (maqūl al-qawl), and «هارون» is a badal (substitute). The clause «هو أفصح» is the khabar (predicate) of «أخي». The preposition «مني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أفصح». «لسانًا»: tamyīz (specification). «ردءًا»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «أرسله», and the clause «يصدِّقني» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ردءًا». The clause «إني أخاف» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The preposition «لكما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object, and the clause «فلا يصلون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نجعل». The preposition «بآياتنا» is attached to «الغالبون». «مَنْ»: a noun conjoined to «أنتما». «الغالبون»: khabar (predicate) of «أنتما». The clause «أنتما ومن اتبعكما الغالبون» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The preposition «بآياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «موسى», i.e. "bearing". «بينات»: ḥāl from «آياتنا». «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «هذا سحر» are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); «مفترى» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause «وما سمعنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ما هذا إلا سحر».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The preposition «بمَنْ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم». «بالهدى» is attached to «جاء», and the preposition «من عنده» is attached to «جاء». «مَنْ» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding «مَنْ», in the position of the genitive. The preposition «له» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «تكون». The clause «إنه لا يفلح» is resumptive, and the hāʾ is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «الملأ»: badal (substitute). «إله»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «إله». «غيري»: naʿt (adjective) of «إله»; it did not become definite through the iḍāfa because it is vague (mubham). The clause «فأوقد» is resumptive. The preposition «لي» is attached to the second object. The clause «لعلي أطلع» is resumptive, and the clause «وإني لأظنه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «لعلي أطلع». The preposition «من الكاذبين» is attached to the second object. The clause «يا هامان» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «هو»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «استكبر», and «جنوده» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the latent pronoun in «استكبر». The preposition «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) and what is conjoined to it. The interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects. The preposition «إلينا» is attached to «يرجعون».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «وجنوده»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ. «كيف»: an interrogative noun, khabar (predicate) of kāna. The clause «فانظر» is conjoined to the clause «نبذناهم», and the clause «كيف كان» is the object of the looking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative and made to include the meaning of knowing.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «يدعون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أئمة». The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينصرون», and the clause «لا يُنصرون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يدعون».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «وأتبعناهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «جعلناهم». The preposition «في هذه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «لعنة». The clause «هم من المقبوحين» is conjoined to the clause «أتبعناهم», and the adverb «يوم» is attached to «المقبوحين».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «ولقد آتينا» is resumptive. «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «بصائر»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكتاب». The preposition «للناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بصائر». The clause «لعلهم يتذكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «وما كنت بجانب» is resumptive. «إذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the "being" (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) of «كانت» is attached, and the clause «قضينا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «وما كنت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one: «وما كنت». [Translator's note: the source writes «كانت» here, though the verse has كنت.]

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «ولكنَّا أنشأنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَمَا كُنْتَ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ}, and the clause «فتطاول» is conjoined to the clause «أنشأنا». The clause «وما كنت ثاويًا» is conjoined to the clause «لكنا أنشأنا», and the clause «تتلو» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «ثاويًا». The preposition «في أهل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ثاويًا». The clause «ولكنا كنا مرسلين» is conjoined to the clause «ما كنت ثاويًا».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: «إذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the "being" (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached. The wāw is a conjunction, «لكن» is for correction (istidrāk), and «رحمة» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) whose governor is omitted, i.e. "We sent you"; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ما كنت». The clause «وما كنت» is conjoined to the clause {وَمَا كُنْتَ} in verse (44). The genitive interpreted maṣdar «لتنذر» is attached to the implied «أرسلناك». «نذير»: fāʿil (agent), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «من قبلك» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «نذير».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «أن» and what follows it are equivalent to a maṣdar, a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "We would not have sent them a messenger". The preposition «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تصيبهم». «لولا أرسلت» is for urging (taḥḍīḍ). The fāʾ in «فنتبع» is causal, and the interpreted maṣdar «أن نتبع» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar taken from the preceding speech, i.e. "why was there not a sending, and so a following of the signs?"

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَلَوْلا أَنْ تُصِيبَهُمْ}. The preposition «من عندنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الحق». «لولا» is for urging (taḥḍīḍ). «مثل»: second object. The clause «يكفروا» is resumptive. The preposition «من قبل» is attached to «أوتي», and the preposition «بكل» is attached to «كافرون».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are truthful, then bring…", and this condition is the content of the implied speech. The preposition «من عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كتاب». The clause «أتبعه» is the apodosis of an implied condition. The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {قُلْ}, and the interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «علم». The clause «ومَنْ أضل» is resumptive; «مَنْ» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أضل» is the khabar (predicate). The preposition «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أضل». The preposition «بغير» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «اتبع». The preposition «من الله» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «هدى».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «ولقد وصَّلنا» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «لعلهم يتذكرون».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The relative clause is resumptive. The preposition «من قبله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the clause «هم يؤمنون» is the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The preposition «من ربنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الحق». The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding resumptive one. The clause «إنه الحق» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clause «إنا كنا». The preposition «من قبله» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «مسلمين».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «أجرهم»: second object. «مرَّتين»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤتون». The clause «ينفقون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يدرءون», and the preposition «مما» is attached to «ينفقون».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {يُنْفِقُونَ}, and the clause «سمعوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «سلام عليكم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «لا نبتغي الجاهلين» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «ولكن الله يهدي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive «إنك لا تهدي», and the clause «وهو أعلم» is conjoined to the clause «يهدي». The preposition «بالمهتدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «معك»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نتبع». The clause «نتخطف» is the apodosis of a condition (jawāb sharṭ). The clause «أولم نمكن» is resumptive. The clause «يُجبى» is a naʿt (adjective) of «حرمًا». «رزقًا»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), synonymous with its governor, because the meaning of «يُجبى إليه» is "He provides for them". The preposition «من لدنا» is attached to a naʿt of «رزقا». The clause of correction (istidrāk) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أولم نمكن».

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The wāw is resumptive. «كم» is the declarative (khabariyya) one, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and the preposition «من قرية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كم». «معيشتها» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). The clause «فتلك مساكنهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أهلكنا», and the clause «بطرت» is a naʿt of «قرية». The clause «لم تسكن من بعدهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مساكنهم». «قليلا»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "they were not inhabited, of the kinds of inhabiting, except a little inhabiting". The clause «وكنا نحن الوارثين» is conjoined to the clause «لم تسكن», and the linking pronoun is implied, i.e. "of them from them". «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr).

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The clause «وما كان ربك مهلك» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «كم أهلكنا», and the genitive interpreted maṣdar «حتى يبعث» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مهلك». The clause «وما كنا مهلكي» is conjoined to the clause «ما كان ربك مهلك». The clause «يتلو» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رسولا», and the clause «وأهلها ظالمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «القرى».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The wāw is resumptive. «ما»: a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a passive past verb, the tāʾ being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The preposition «من شيء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما». The fāʾ is the linking one (rābiṭa). «متاع»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو" (it). The wāw in «وما عند الله» is a conjunction; «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and «عند» is an adverb attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «وما عند الله خير» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive «وما أوتيتم», and the clause «أفلا تعقلون» is resumptive. [Translator's note: the source says only "and a passive past verb" without naming it; the verb is «أوتيتم».]

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The clause «أفمن وعدناه» is resumptive, and the clause «فهو لاقيه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila (relative clause) «وعدناه». The preposition «كمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the relative noun. «متاع»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «يوم»: an adverb attached to «المحضرين». The clause «ثم هو من المحضرين» is conjoined to the clause «متَّعْنَاه».

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يوم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) "اذكر" (remember); the clause "واذكر يوم" is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {أَفَمَنْ وَعَدْنَاهُ}. «أين»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). «شركائي»: mubtadaʾ (subject). «الذين»: naʿt (adjective) of شركائي. The two objects of «تزعمون» are implied, i.e. "you claim that they are My partners".

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «هؤلاء الذين» are mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the pronoun referring back to the relative noun in «أغوينا» is implied, i.e. "أغويناهم" (we misled them). It is not permissible for «الذين» to be a naʿt (adjective) and the clause «أغويناهم» the khabar, because the khabar would then carry no additional information beyond what is in its adjective. His words «كما»: the kāf is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya; the implied form is "we misled them with a misleading, so they erred with an erring like our erring". «إيانا»: a detached accusative pronoun, an object placed first. The clause «أغويناهم» is resumptive, and likewise the two clauses «تبرَّأنا» and «ما كانوا».

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The clause «فدعَوْهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قيل». The interpreted maṣdar «أن كانوا» is the fāʿil (agent) of (ثبت). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, the implied form being "had their being rightly guided been established, they would not have seen the punishment". The conditional clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: His words «ويوم»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «يوم» that precedes in verse (62). «ماذا»: an interrogative noun, mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). It is not permissible to take its implied form as "ما الذي أجبتم به؟" (what is that with which you answered?) and then that the genitive referring pronoun was omitted, because it would be without the condition for its omission being met.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «فعميت» is resumptive, and the clause «فهم لا يتساءلون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one.

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: «فأما»: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl). «مَنْ»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). «صالحًا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «فعسى أن يكون»: the fāʾ is the linking one (rābiṭa), «عسى» is a complete (tāmm) past verb, and the interpreted maṣdar is its fāʿil (agent). Taking «مَنْ» as relative is preferred over taking it as conditional so that two conditional particles do not come together. The clause «فعسى أن يكون» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «مَنْ».

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «وربك يخلق» is resumptive. «سبحان»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar «عمَّا يشركون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تعالى», i.e. "He is exalted above their associating". The clause «ما كان لهم الخيرة» is resumptive, and likewise the clause (نسبح سبحان); the clause «وتعالى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نسبح».

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: The clause «وهو الله» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ربك يعلم». The clause of declaring transcendence [Translator's note: «لا إله إلا هو»] is a second khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «هو», and the clause «له الحمد» is a third khabar. His words «إلا هو»: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «هو» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar. The preposition «في الأولى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الحمد». The clause «ترجعون» is conjoined to the clause «له الحمد».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The first object of «أرأيتم» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to «الليل»; the two verbs «رأيتم» and «جعل» contend (tanāzuʿ) for «الليل», and «جعل» was made to govern because it is closer to it. The two objects of جعل are «الليل سرمدًا». The clause «إن جعل» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, explained by the interrogative clause. The preposition «إلى يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «سرمدا». «مَنْ إله»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). «غير»: naʿt. The clause «مَنْ إله» is the second object of «أرأيتم», and the clause «يأتيكم» is a second naʿt of «إله». The clause «أفلا تسمعون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: (قل أرأيتم إن جعل الله عليكم النهار سرمدا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] Like the preceding verse, in its single words and its clauses.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The wāw in «ومِنْ رحمته» is resumptive. The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. The interpreted maṣdar «لتسكنوا» is genitive, attached to «جعل», and the second maṣdar is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first maṣdar, i.e. "for resting and for seeking". The clause «ولعلكم تشكرون» is conjoined to the preceding genitive single word, i.e. "and for seeking, and that you may be grateful".

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is resumptive, and «يوم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) "اذكر" (remember); the clause «يناديهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «أين»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «شركائي». The two objects of the claiming are omitted, i.e. "you claim that they are partners".

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The clause «نزعنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {يُنَادِيهِمْ}, and the clause «قلنا» is conjoined to the clause «نزعنا». «هاتوا»: an inflexible (jāmid) imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). The interpreted maṣdar «أن الحق لله» stands in place of the two objects of علم. «ما كانوا»: a relative noun, fāʿil.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The clause «فبغى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «كان». The preposition «من الكنوز» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آتيناه». «ما»: a relative noun, second object. «أولي»: naʿt (adjective) of العصبة, genitive with yāʾ. The clause «إن مفاتحه لتنوء» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal relative. «إذ»: an adverb of time attached to an implied verb, i.e. "he displayed joy when…", and the implied clause is resumptive. The clause «إن الله لا يحب الفرحين» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: His words «فيما»: «في» is causal, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The kāf in «كما» is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. "do good, a doing of good like Allah's doing of good". The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to the maṣdar (الفساد).

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: «إنما»: the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa), having no governing effect. The preposition «على علم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The adverb «عندي» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «علم». The clause «أولم يعلم» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of علم. «قوة»: tamyīz (specification). The clause «ولا يسأل» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: The clause «فخرج» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause {قَالَ}. The preposition «في زينته» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خرج». «ما»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «إنه لذو حظ» is a ḥāl from «قارون».

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: «العلم»: second object. «ويلكم»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an unused (muhmal) verb. The preposition «لِمَنْ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير». «صالحًا»: second object. The clause «ولا يلقَّاها إلا الصابرون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ثواب الله خير»; «الصابرون» is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). [Translator's note: the source calls «صالحًا» a "second object"; in the verse it is the object of «عمل».]

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: The clause «فخسفنا» is resumptive, and the fāʾ in «فما» is resumptive. The preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna. «فئة»: ism (subject) of kāna, and «مِن» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «ينصرونه» is a naʿt (adjective). The preposition «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ينصرونه». The clause «وما كان من المنتصرين» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «فما كان له».

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: «مكانه»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the original being "مثل مكانه" (the like of his position). «وي»: a verbal noun of imperfect sense (ism fiʿl muḍāriʿ) meaning "I marvel", and [Translator's note: «كأنّ»] an abrogating particle and its ism. The preposition «من عباده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مَنْ». «لولا»: a particle of non-occurrence because of occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), and the interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being "were it not that His favour exists". The conditional clause is resumptive, and likewise the clause «ويكأنه» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: «الدار»: badal (substitute), and the clause «نجعلها» is the khabar (predicate). The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عُلُوًّا». The clause «والعاقبة للمتقين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The clause «فلا يجزى الذين» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); it is a case of putting the overt noun in place of the pronoun, the original being «فلا يجزون». In attributing the doing of evil to them in a repeated form there is extra censure of their state and an increase in making evil hateful in the hearts of the listeners. The technical original is "فهم لا يجزون" (then they are not recompensed), because the negating «لا» is not one of the places of the fāʾ. «ما» in His words «ما كانوا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The lām in «لَرَادُّكَ» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The preposition «إلى معاد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رَادُّكَ». The clause «قل ربي أعلم» is resumptive. «مَنْ»: a relative noun, the object of an implied (muqaddar) «يعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The clause «وما كنت» is resumptive. The maṣdar «أن يلقى» is the object of «ترجو». «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). «رحمة»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and the exception is from the generality of states. The preposition «من ربك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة». The clause «فلا تكونن» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «وما كنت»; the verb is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, its ism is the pronoun of the addressee, and «ظهيرًا» is its khabar (predicate). The preposition «للكافرين» is attached to «ظهيرًا».

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: «بعد»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «يصدنَّك». «إذ»: an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: «مع»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «إلهًا». The clause of declaring transcendence is resumptive. «إلا هو»: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «هو» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause «كل شيء هالك» is resumptive. «إلا» is for exception, and «وجهه» is the excepted, accusative. The clause «له الحكم» is resumptive, and the clause «ترجعون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «له الحكم».

mekki-muskil:2-2.t: His saying, exalted is He, {تِلْكَ آيَات الْكتاب الْمُبين}: تلك is in the position of the nominative in the sense "this is that" (هَذِه تِلْكَ), and آيات is a badal (substitute) for it. In ordinary speech تلك may be in the position of the accusative by نتلوا, and you would put آيات in the accusative as a badal for تلك.

mekki-muskil:4-4.t:
His saying {وَجعل أَهلهَا شيعًا}: two objects of جعل, because it has the meaning of صيّر ("to make into"). If it has the meaning of خلق ("to create"), it takes one object, as in His saying {وَجعل الظُّلُمَات والنور}. And خلق, when it has the meaning of صيّر, takes two objects, as in {ثمَّ خلقنَا النُّطْفَة علقَة}; and if it has the meaning of "to originate, to bring into being", it takes one object, as in {خلق الله السَّمَاوَات}.
His saying {قُرَّة عين}: nominative by an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "he is a comfort of the eye for me". It may also be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar (predicate) is لا تقتلوه. It may also be accusative by an implied verb which لا تقتلوه explains, its implied form being "leave a comfort of the eye; do not kill him".

mekki-muskil:10-10.t: His saying {لَوْلَا أَن ربطنا على قَلبهَا}: أن is in the position of the nominative and the apodosis (jawāb) is omitted. Its explanation has already been given.

mekki-muskil:14-14.t: His saying {بلغ أشده}: according to Sībawayh its pattern is أفعل, and in his view it is the plural of شدّة, like نعمة and أنعم. Others said it is the plural of شدّ, like قِدّ and أقدّ. It is also said that it is a singular, though in the language there is no singular noun on the pattern أفعُل without the tāʾ marbūṭa except أصبع in some of its dialectal forms.

mekki-muskil:15-15.t: His saying {وَهَذَا من عدوه}: i.e. "of his enemies". Its meaning is that when an onlooker looked at the two of them, he would say that.

mekki-muskil:18-18.t:
His saying {خَائفًا}: the khabar (predicate) of أصبح; or, if you wish, as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with في المدينة as the khabar.
His saying {فَإِذا الَّذِي استنصره بالْأَمْس يستصرخه}: الذي is a mubtadaʾ (subject), what follows it is its ṣila (relative clause), and يستصرخه is the khabar. It is also permissible for إذا to be the khabar and يستصرخه a ḥāl.
His saying تمشي: in the position of a ḥāl from {إِحْدَاهمَا}, governed by جاءت. {على استحياء} is in the position of a ḥāl from the latent pronoun in تمشي, governed by تمشي. على استحياء may also be in the position of a ḥāl placed first, from the latent pronoun in قالت, governed by قالت; the first is better. On the second view it is good to pause at تمشي; on the first view it is not good to pause except at على استحياء.

mekki-muskil:28-28.t:
His saying {قَالَ ذَلِك بيني وَبَيْنك}: ذلك is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and what follows it is its khabar (predicate); its meaning according to Sībawayh is "that is between us".
His saying {أَيّمَا الْأَجَليْنِ قضيت}: you make أيا accusative by قضيت, and ما is redundant (zāʾida) for emphasis, and you put الأجلين in the genitive because أي is annexed to it. Ibn Kaysān said: ما is in the position of the genitive because أي is annexed to it, and it is indefinite, and الأجلين is a badal (substitute) for ما. He said the same about His saying {فبمَا رَحْمَة من الله}: that رحمة is a badal for ما. He used to take pains not to make anything in the Qur'an redundant, and would devise for it an interpretation that takes it out of redundancy.

mekki-muskil:30-30.t: His saying {أَن يَا مُوسَى}: أن is in the position of the accusative by omission of the preposition, i.e. "with (بأن) 'O Moses'".

mekki-muskil:31-31.t:
His saying {أَن ألق عصاك}: conjoined to it.
His saying {مُدبرا}: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); likewise the position of His saying ولم يعقب is also in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

mekki-muskil:32-32.t:
His saying {من الرهب}: attached to (mutaʿalliq) ولّى, i.e. "he turned back fleeing out of fear".
His saying {فذانك}: it is the dual of the nominative ذا, and it is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject). The alif of ذا is elided because the alif of the dual entered upon it. Whoever reads it with the nūn doubled made the doubling a compensation for the loss of the alif of ذا. It is also said that whoever doubles it based it only on the dialect of those who say ذلك in the singular; when he made it dual, he kept the lām after the nūn of the dual, then assimilated the lām into the nūn according to the rule of assimilating the second into the first. The rule is always to assimilate the first into the second, unless some cause prevents that, in which case the second is assimilated into the first. The cause that prevented assimilating the first into the second here is that, had that been done, a doubled lām would have stood in the place of the nūn that indicates the dual, and the form of the dual would have changed; so the second was assimilated into the first for that reason, and it became a doubled nūn. It has also been said that when he made it dual he kept the lām that is in ذلك before the nūn, then assimilated the first into the second according to the principles of assimilation, and it became a doubled nūn. It is also said that the nūn in these vague nouns (al-mubhamāt) is doubled only to distinguish between the nūn that is a compensation for a vowel and tanwīn, or for tanwīn — something present or implied in the singular — and that which is not present in the singular. It is also said that it was doubled to distinguish between the nūn that is dropped in annexation and the nūn that is never dropped in annexation, which is the nūn of the dual of the vague noun. The same is the reason for doubling the nūn in اللذان and اللذين and هذان and the like.

mekki-muskil:34-34.t: His saying {ردْءًا}: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in أرسله. Likewise يصدقني is a ḥāl in the reading of whoever puts it in the nominative, or a naʿt (adjective) of ردء; whoever puts it in the jussive does so as the answer to the request.

mekki-muskil:42-42.t:
His saying {وَيَوْم الْقِيَامَة هم من المقبوحين}: يوم is accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), as though He said "and We made a curse follow them in this world, and a curse of the Day of Resurrection"; then the (second) curse was omitted because the first indicates it, and يوم stood in its place and took its accusative. You may also put اليوم in the accusative by conjoining it to the position of في هذه الدنيا, as (the poet) said:
.. إِذا مَا تلاقينا من الْيَوْم أَو غَدا ...
(When we meet, today or tomorrow.)
يوم may also be accusative as an adverb of المقبوحين, i.e. "and they will be among the despised on the Day of Resurrection", with the adverb then placed first.

mekki-muskil:43-43.t: His saying بصائر وَهدى وَرَحْمَة: all accusative as aḥwāl (circumstantial expressions) from الكتاب.

mekki-muskil:46-46.t: His saying {وَلَكِن رَحْمَة من رَبك}: الرحمة is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun) according to al-Akhfash, meaning "but your Lord had mercy on you, O Muhammad, with a mercy". According to al-Zajjāj it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "but He did that for mercy", i.e. for the sake of mercy. Al-Kisāʾī said it is the khabar (predicate) of an implied كان, meaning "but that was a mercy from your Lord". In ordinary speech the nominative is permissible, meaning "but it is a mercy".

mekki-muskil:58-58.t: His saying {بطرت معيشتها}: المعيشة is accusative according to al-Māzinī by omission of the preposition, its implied form being "it exulted in its livelihood" (بطرت في معيشتها). Al-Farrāʾ said it is accusative as specification (tafsīr, i.e. tamyīz), but this is far-fetched, because it is definite and tamyīz can only be indefinite. It is also said that it is accusative by بطرت, with بطرت meaning "was ignorant of", i.e. "it was ignorant of gratitude for its livelihood", then the muḍāf was omitted.

mekki-muskil:68-68.t: His saying {وَرَبك يخلق مَا يَشَاء ويختار مَا كَانَ}: the second ما is for negation and has no grammatical position. Some scholars — al-Ṭabarī and others — said it is in the position of the accusative by يختار. That is not good in i'rab, because there is no returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) in the sentence referring to ما. It is also far-fetched in meaning and in creed, because its being for negation requires that it cover all things — that they came about by the decree of Allah and His choice, and that the servant has nothing in them other than his acquisition (iktisāb), by a decree from Allah. Whereas if you make ما in the position of the accusative by يختار, it does not cover all things as being chosen by Allah; it only requires that He chooses that in which they have the choice, nothing else, and negates that in which they have no choice — and this is the doctrine of the Qadariyya and the Muʿtazila. So ما being for negation is more fitting in meaning, more correct in interpretation, better in creed and stronger in Arabic. Do you not see that if you made ما in the position of the accusative, its pronoun in كان would be its ism (noun), and it would be necessary to put الخيرة in the accusative — yet no one has read it so? It has been said in the interpretation of this verse that its meaning is: "and your Lord, O Muhammad, creates what He wills and chooses for His friendship (walāya) and His message whomever He wants". Then He began by negating choice from the polytheists, and that they have no power, saying "they have no choice", i.e. friendship, the message and other things are not by their choice nor by their wish. And Allah knows best what He means by that. This verse needs much more extensive treatment than this, and what we have pointed to is sufficient.

mekki-muskil:76-76.t: His saying {مَا إِن مفاتحه لتنوء}: ما is in the position of the accusative by آتيناه as a second object, and إنّ with its ism (noun) and khabar (predicate), and what is connected to it up to His saying أولي القوة, is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. The singular of أولي is ذي.

mekki-muskil:82-82.t: His saying ويكأن الله: its origin is وي, separate from the kāf. Sībawayh said, citing al-Khalīl, about its meaning: the people became aware, or were made aware, and said وي; it is a word that the remorseful says when he shows his remorse. Al-Farrāʾ said: وي is joined to the kāf, and its origin is ويلك أن الله ("woe to you, that Allah…"); then the lām was elided and the kāf joined to أن. There is something far-fetched in this, in meaning and in i'rab, because the people were not addressing anyone, because eliding the lām from this is not known, and because أن would then have had to be with kasra, since nothing requires its fatḥa.

mekki-muskil:88-88.t:
His saying {كل شَيْء هَالك إِلَّا وَجهه}: الوجه is accusative by exception. In ordinary speech the nominative is permissible in the sense of an adjective, as though He said "other than His Face" (غير وجهه), as (the poet) said:
... وكل أَخ مفارقه أَخُوهُ ... لعمر أَبِيك إِلَّا الفرقدان ...
(And every brother is parted from by his brother — by your father's life — except the two Farqad stars.)
i.e. "other than the two Farqad stars", so غير is an adjective of كل; such is the permissibility (of the nominative) in the verse.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿فالتقطه آل فرعون ليكون لهم عدوا وحزنا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted clause); (التقطه): a past verb, and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (آل): a postponed fāʿil (agent); (فرعون): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ليكون): the lām is of consequence (al-ʿāqiba), and it has been said: of causation (taʿlīl); (يكون): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿التقطه﴾; the noun (ism) of يكون is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يكون﴾; (عدوًّا): the khabar (predicate) of يكون; (حزنًا): conjoined to ﴿عدوًّا﴾.
﴿إن فرعون وهامان وجنودهما كانوا خاطئين﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and (فرعون) is its noun; ﴿وهامان وجنودهما﴾: conjoined to فرعون; the clause (كانوا) is the khabar of إن; (كان) is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and (خاطئين) is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وقالت امرأت فرعون قرت عين لي ولك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قالت): conjoined to ﴿فالتقطه آل فرعون﴾; ﴿امرأة فرعون﴾: fāʿil (agent) and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قرة عين): the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "هو قرة عين"; (لي): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element, two naʿts (adjectives) of قرة [Translator's note: so in the source: "صفتان" (two adjectives) after only لي has been mentioned; presumably لي and لك together]; (لك): conjoined to ﴿لي﴾.
﴿لا تقتلوه عسى أن ينفعنا أو نتخذه ولدا وهم لا يشعرون﴾: (لا) is prohibitive; (تقتلوه): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عسى): a past verb among the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ), its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أن ينفعنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of عسى, accusative (manṣūb); (أو نتخذه): conjoined to ينفعنا; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and (ولدًا) the second mafʿūl bihi; (وهم): the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (لا يشعرون): khabar; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿آل فرعون﴾.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وأصبح فؤاد أم موسى فارغا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (أصبح): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (فؤاد): its noun; (أم موسى): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (فارغًا): its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿وأصبح فؤاد...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن كادت لتبدي به لولا أن ربطنا على قلبها لتكون من المؤمنين﴾: (إن) is lightened from the heavy (inna), inoperative (muhmala); (كادت): a past verb among the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba), its noun is latent (mustatir); the lām is the differentiating lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); the clause (تبدي): the khabar (predicate) of كاد; (به): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تبدي﴾; (لولا): a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd); (أن): maṣdariyya, and together with what it governs it is equivalent to a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "لولا ربطنا على قلبها حاصل"; (على قلبها): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ربطنا﴾; the apodosis (jawāb) of لولا is omitted, i.e. "لأبدت به"; (لتكون): the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), and (تكون) is an incomplete imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿ربطنا﴾ as well; (من المؤمنين): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of تكون.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿وقالت لأخته قصيه فبصرت به عن جنب وهم لا يشعرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (قالت): a past verb, and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "هي", i.e. the mother of Moses; (لأخته): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قالت﴾; (قصيه): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the yāʾ is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (فبصرت): the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (به): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿بصرت﴾; (عن جنب): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of بصرت, i.e. "بصرت به مستخفية كائنة عن جنب", or of the pronoun in به, i.e. "بعيدًا"; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause (لا يشعرون): khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وحرمنا عليه المراضع من قبل فقالت هل أدلكم على أهل بيت يكفلونه لكم وهم له ناصحون﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (حرمنا): verb and fāʿil (agent); (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حرمنا﴾; (المراضع): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿وحرمنا عليه المراضع﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (من قبل): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to ﴿حرمنا﴾; (فقالت): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted clause); (هل): an interrogative particle; (أدلكم): an imperfect verb, the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنا", and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; (على أهل بيت): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أدلكم﴾; the clause (يكفلونه): a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أهل بيت﴾; (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يكفلونه﴾; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ناصحون﴾; (ناصحون): khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿فرددناه إلى أمه كي تقر عينها ولا تحزن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (رددناه): verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلى أمه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رددناه﴾; (كي): a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تقر): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿كي﴾, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from كي and the verb is in the position of genitive by the omitted lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿رددناه﴾; (ولا تحزن): conjoined to تقر.
﴿ولتعلم أن وعد الله حق ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), and (تعلم): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; أن and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of تعلم; (أن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (وعد) is its noun, and (حق): its khabar (predicate); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (ولكن أكثرهم): لكن is an abrogating particle, (أكثر) is its noun, and ﴿هم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause (لا يعلمون): its khabar.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿ولما بلغ أشده واستوى آتيناه حكما وعلما وكذلك نجزي المحسنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (لما): temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"), or linking (rābiṭa); (بلغ): a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; (أشده): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (استوى): conjoined to بلغ; the clause (آتيناه) has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim); (آتيناه): a past verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi; (حكمًا): second mafʿūl bihi; (علمًا): conjoined to ﴿حكمًا﴾; the clause ﴿ولما بلغ...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor, i.e. "وجزاءً مثلَ ذلك نجزي المحسنين"; (ذلك): ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿نجزي﴾ is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "نحن", and ﴿المحسنين﴾ is mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿ودخل المدينة على حين غفلة من أهلها﴾: ﴿ودخل المدينة﴾: conjoined to something omitted; (دخل المدينة): verb, latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and an object by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); (على حين غفلة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of المدينة, or of the fāʿil of دخل, i.e. "مختلسًا" (stealthily); (من أهلها): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of غفلة.
﴿فوجد فيها رجلين يقتتلان هذا من شيعته وهذا من عدوه﴾: (فوجد): conjoined to دخل; (فيها): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿وجد﴾; (رجلين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (يقتتلان): a naʿt of رجلين; (هذا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (من شيعته): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is a second naʿt of رجلين, and it has been said a ḥāl; ﴿وهذا من عدوه﴾: conjoined to it.
﴿فاستغاثه الذي من شيعته على الذي من عدوه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (استغاثه): a past verb and mafʿūl bihi; (الذي): fāʿil; (من شيعته): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿فوكزه موسى فقضى عليه قال هذا من عمل الشيطان إنه عدو مضل مبين﴾: (فوكزه): likewise conjoined; (موسى): fāʿil (agent); (فقضى عليه): conjoined to فوكزه; (قال): a past verb, and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (هذا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (من عمل الشيطان): khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause (إنه عدو): causal (taʿlīl); (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and (عدو) is its khabar; (مضل): naʿt (adjective); (مبين): a second naʿt.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿قال رب بما أنعمت علي فلن أكون ظهيرا للمجرمين﴾: (بما): the bāʾ is a particle of oath and genitive, and the apodosis of the oath (jawāb al-qasam) is omitted, its implied form being "أقسم بإنعامك علي بالمغفرة لأتوبن"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) is genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ of the oath; the fāʾ conjoins to the omitted apodosis; (لن): a particle of negation, accusative-governing and future; (أكون): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنا"; (ظهيرًا): its khabar; (للمجرمين): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ظهيرًا﴾; and it has been said: the bāʾ and what it governs are attached to an implied ﴿اعصمني﴾, and the fāʾ in ﴿فلن أكون﴾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it is the apodosis of an implied condition.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿قال رب إني ظلمت نفسي فاغفر لي فغفر له إنه هو الغفور الرحيم﴾: ﴿رب﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿ظلمت نفسي﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إن; (فاغفر لي): the fāʾ is a conjunction, (اغفر) is a verb of supplication, and (لي): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اغفر﴾; (فغفر له): conjoined; (إن) is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, ﴿هو﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), (الغفور): khabar, and (الرحيم): a second khabar; or ﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الغفور الرحيم): two khabars of it, and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿فأصبح في المدينة خائفا يترقب﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أصبح): an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; (في المدينة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (خائفًا): the khabar (predicate) of أصبح; or (في المدينة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of أصبح, and (خائفًا): ḥāl; or the verb ﴿أصبح﴾ is complete (tāmm) and its fāʿil (agent) is latent, (في المدينة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it, and (خائفًا) is a ḥāl; the clause (يترقب): a second ḥāl, or a second khabar, or a ḥāl of the pronoun in ﴿خائفًا﴾; the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يترقب is omitted, i.e. "يترقب المكروه" (awaiting what is dreaded).
﴿فإذا الذي استنصره بالأمس يستصرخه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إذا): of surprise (fujāʾiyya); (الذي): mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (استنصره): the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; (بالأمس): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿استنصر﴾; the clause (يستصرخه): the khabar of الذي; and what يستصرخه is attached to is omitted, i.e. "على قبطي آخر" (against another Copt).
﴿قال له موسى إنك لغوي مبين﴾: (قال): a past verb; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it; (موسى): fāʿil; (إنك): (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the kāf is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and (غوي مبين): two khabars of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿فلما أن أراد أن يبطش بالذي هو عدو لهما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (لما): temporal (ḥīniyya), or linking (rābiṭa); (أن): connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); (أراد): a past verb; أن and what follows it are equivalent to a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أراد; (بالذي): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبطش﴾; ﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); (عدو): khabar (predicate); (لهما): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿هو عدو لهما﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿قال يا موسى أتريد أن تقتلني كما قتلت نفسا بالأمس﴾: (قال): a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); (أتريد): the hamza is for interrogation, (تريد) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and أن and what lies within its scope are the mafʿūl bihi of تريد; ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the implied form being "تقتلني قتلا مثلَ قتلك نفسًا بالأمس"; ﴿قتلت﴾ is verb and fāʿil, (نفسًا) mafʿūl bihi; (بالأمس): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قتلت﴾; the clause ﴿قتلت﴾ is the ṣila of the particle relative ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن تريد إلا أن تكون جبارا في الأرض وما تريد أن تكون من المصلحين﴾: (إن) is negating; (تريد): an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); أن and what follows it are equivalent to a maṣdar that is the mafʿūl bihi of تريد; (جبارًا): the khabar of تكون; (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿جبارًا﴾; (ما) is negating; (تريد): an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت"; أن and what follows it are equivalent to a maṣdar that is the mafʿūl bihi of تريد; ﴿من المصلحين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of تكون.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿وجاء رجل من أقصى المدينة يسعى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (جاء رجل): verb and fāʿil (agent); (من أقصى المدينة): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رجل, and the clause (يسعى): a second naʿt, or a ḥāl (circumstantial); or (من أقصى المدينة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جاء﴾, and the clause (يسعى): a naʿt only.
﴿قال يا موسى إن الملأ يأتمرون بك ليقتلوك فاخرج إني لك من الناصحين﴾: (إن الملأ): (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (الملأ) is its noun, and the clause (يأتمرون): the khabar (predicate) of إن; (بك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأتمرون﴾; (ليقتلوك): the lām is of causation (taʿlīliyya), and (يقتلوك) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after it, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يأتمرون﴾; (فاخرج): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (implying an omitted clause), i.e. "إن سمعت نصيحتي فاخرج" (if you heed my advice, then leave); (إني): (إن) is an abrogating particle and the yāʾ is its noun; (لك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, and it has been said: attached to ﴿الناصحين﴾; ﴿من الناصحين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿فخرج منها خائفا يترقب قال رب نجني من القوم الظالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (منها): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خرج﴾; (خائفًا): ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause (يترقب): a second ḥāl, and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يترقب is omitted, i.e. "الشر" (harm), or their catching up with him, and it has been said: he awaited Allah's rescue; (رب): the one addressed (munādā); (نجني): a verb of supplication, and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; (من القوم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نجني﴾; (الظالمين): naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿ولما توجه تلقاء مدين قال عسى ربي أن يهديني سواء السبيل﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); (لما) is an adverb meaning "when" (ḥīna) containing the sense of condition; (توجه): a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; (تلقاء مدين): an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿توجه﴾; (مدين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), made a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf) for being a proper name and feminine; the clause ﴿قال...﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim); (عسى): an inflexible (jāmid) past verb among the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ); (ربي): its noun; أن and what lies within its scope are its khabar (predicate); (سواء السبيل): a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); the clause ﴿ولما توجه...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ولما ورد ماء مدين وجد عليه أمة من الناس يسقون﴾: (وجد): a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وجد﴾; (أمة): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من الناس): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أمة; the clause (يسقون): a second naʿt, or a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the mafʿūl bihi of يسقون is omitted since it is known, i.e. "مواشيهم" (their livestock).
﴿ووجد من دونهم امرأتين تذودان﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (وجد): conjoined to the first وجد; (من دونهم): a preposition and its genitive noun likewise attached to ﴿وجد﴾; (امرأتين): first mafʿūl bihi; the clause (تذودان): a naʿt of امرأتين. [Translator's note: so in the source, "first mafʿūl bihi", although no second object is named.]
﴿قال ما خطبكما قالتا لا نسقي حتى يصدر الرعاء وأبونا شيخ كبير﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (خطبكما): khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (قالتا): a past verb, the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine, given a fatḥa to suit the alif of the dual, and the alif is the fāʿil; the clause (لا نسقي): the object of their saying; (حتى): a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive; (يصدر): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿نسقي﴾; (الرعاء): fāʿil; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (أبونا): mubtadaʾ; (شيخ): khabar; (كبير): naʿt.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿فسقى لهما ثم تولى إلى الظل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted and implied; (سقى): a past verb; (لهما): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سقى﴾; the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted, i.e. "غنمهما لأجلهما" (their sheep, for their sake); (ثم): a conjunction; (تولى): a past verb; (إلى الظل): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تولى﴾.
﴿فقال رب إني لما أنزلت إلي من خير فقير﴾: (رب): the one addressed (munādā); (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun; (لما): the lām is a preposition, and (ما) is an indefinite noun meaning "thing", or a relative noun, i.e. "for whatever thing", or "for that which You sent down"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿فقير﴾; (أنزلت): verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أنزلت﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾, or the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; (إلي): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أنزلت﴾; (من خير): ḥāl (circumstantial); (فقير): the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿فجاءته إحداهما تمشي على استحياء﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (إحداهما): fāʿil (agent); the clause (تمشي): a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil; (على استحياء): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil latent in تمشي, i.e. "مستحيية" (bashfully).
﴿قالت إن أبي يدعوك ليجزيك أجر ما سقيت لنا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (أبي) is its noun, and the clause (يدعوك): its khabar (predicate); (ليجزيك): the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), (يجزيك): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يدعوك﴾; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أجر): second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and it with what follows is equivalent to a maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "أجر سقايتك" (the wage of your watering); (لنا): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿سقيت﴾.
﴿فلما جاءه وقص عليه القصص قال لا تخف نجوت من القوم الظالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (قص): a past verb; (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قص﴾; (القصص): mafʿūl bihi; the clause (قال): has no grammatical position; (لا) is prohibitive; (تخف): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; (نجوت): verb and fāʿil (agent); (من القوم): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نجوت﴾; ﴿الظالمين﴾ is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿قالت إحداهما يا أبت استأجره﴾: (قالت إحداهما): verb and fāʿil (agent); (يا) is a vocative particle; (أبت): the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, for which the tāʾ is a substitute; (استأجره): imperative verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إن خير من استأجرت القوي الأمين﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason for the command before it; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), (خير) is its noun, ﴿من﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause (استأجرت): the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; (القوي): first khabar (predicate); (الأمين): second khabar.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿قال إني أريد أن أنكحك إحدى ابنتي هاتين﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause (أريد): its khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (أن أنكحك): equivalent to a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أريد; the fāʿil (agent) of أنكحك is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا"; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi; (إحدى): second mafʿūl bihi; (ابنتي): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (هاتين): naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ابنتي﴾.
﴿على أن تأجرني ثماني حجج﴾: (على): a preposition that enters upon أن and what follows it, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil or of the mafʿūl, i.e. "مشروطًا علي، أو عليك ذلك" (that being stipulated upon me, or upon you); (تأجرني): an imperfect verb, and the second object of تأجرني is omitted, i.e. "نفسك" (yourself); (ثماني): an adverb (ẓarf) for تأجرني; and it has been said: ثماني is a second object of تأجرني, which requires assuming an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "رعى ثماني حجج" (herding for eight years) [Translator's note: so in the source, "مفعولًا ثانيًا" in the accusative]; (حجج): muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فإن أتممت عشرا فمن عندك﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional; (أتممت): a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (عشرًا): mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb), because it is a nominal clause; (من عندك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "فالتمام من عندك" (then the completion is from you).
﴿وما أريد أن أشق عليك ستجدني إن شاء الله من الصالحين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is negating; (أريد): an imperfect verb, and a latent fāʿil, its implied form being "أنا"; أن and what lies within its scope are the mafʿūl bihi of أريد; (عليك): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أشق﴾; (ستجدني): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنت", the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿إن شاء الله﴾: parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), a clause with no grammatical position, and the apodosis of the condition (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; (من الصالحين): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تجدني﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿قال ذلك بيني وبينك أيما الأجلين قضيت فلا عدوان علي والله على ما نقول وكيل﴾: (ذلك): mubtadaʾ (subject); (بيني وبينك): its khabar (predicate); (أيما الأجلين): (أي) is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿قضيت﴾, and (ما) is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); and it has been said: ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun meaning "thing", and (الأجلين) is a badal (substitute) of it; (قضيت): verb and fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb); (لا) is the lā of generic negation; (عدوان): its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; (علي): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of لا. (الله): mubtadaʾ. ﴿على ما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿وكيل﴾. The clause ﴿نقول﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. (وكيل): the khabar of الله.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿فلما قضى موسى الأجل وسار بأهله آنس من جانب الطور نارا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (لما): temporal (ḥīniyya), or linking (rābiṭa); the clause ﴿قضى موسى الأجل﴾ has no grammatical position; (سار): conjoined to قضى; (بأهله): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سار﴾; the clause (آنس) has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim); ﴿من جانب الطور﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿آنس﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نارًا﴾ and was placed before it; (نارًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قال لأهله امكثوا إني آنست نارا﴾: (لأهله): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قال﴾; the clause (امكثوا): the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause ﴿إني﴾ gives the reason for the command to stay; (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, the clause (آنست) is its khabar (predicate), and (نارًا) is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لعلي آتيكم منها بخبر أو جذوة من النار لعلكم تصطلون﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle of hope (tarajjī), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause (آتيكم) is its khabar; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; (منها): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was a naʿt of خبر; (بخبر): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿آتيكم﴾; (أو): a conjunction; (جذوة): conjoined to خبر; (من النار): a naʿt of جذوة; the clause of hope is also a ḥāl; (لعل) is an abrogating particle of hope, ﴿كم﴾ is its noun, and the clause (تصطلون) is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿فلما أتاها نودي من شاطئ الواد الأيمن في البقعة المباركة من الشجرة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; the clause (نودي) has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim); (من شاطئ): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نودي﴾; (الواد): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the omitted yāʾ; (الأيمن): a naʿt (adjective) of شاطئ, or a naʿt of الوادي; (في البقعة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الشاطئ; (المباركة): naʿt of البقعة; (من الشجرة): a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted element that is a badal (substitute) of His words ﴿من شاطئ الوادي﴾, a badal of inclusion (badal al-ishtimāl).
﴿أن يا موسى إني أنا الله رب العالمين﴾: (أن): explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause ﴿يا موسى...﴾ is explicative, a clause with no grammatical position; (إني): (إن) is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the yāʾ is its noun; (أنا): a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), or a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الله): the khabar (predicate) of إن, or the khabar of أنا, and the clause is the khabar of إن; (رب العالمين): a naʿt of the Majestic Name, or a badal of it.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
